# appCapabilitiesGetByMask

<!-- @constructive-io/graphql-codegen - DO NOT EDIT -->

Reads and enables pagination through a set of `AppCapability`.

## Usage

```typescript
useAppCapabilitiesGetByMaskQuery({ after: '<Cursor>', first: '<Int>', mask: '<BitString>', offset: '<Int>' })
```

## Examples

### Use useAppCapabilitiesGetByMaskQuery

```typescript
const { data, isLoading } = useAppCapabilitiesGetByMaskQuery({ after: '<Cursor>', first: '<Int>', mask: '<BitString>', offset: '<Int>' });
```
